verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration services provider, so whether it offers the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) pathway is a fair question. The evidence pack documents O-1A, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, TN, E-3, L-1A, E-2 and H-4 pages, but nothing mentions International Entrepreneur Rule parole or its qualifying-investment thresholds.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated
